root.label: Accused Cornell student files challenge to disciplinary punishment

events.label: Accused Cornell student files challenge to disciplinary punishment

slots.name: report pages
slots.sentence: They include a 99-page report on a campus hearing panel’s disciplinary findings and a summary of events submitted by the university’s lawyers.

slots.name: investigation interviews
slots.sentence: the records show the breadth of the university’s inquiry — including 50 interviews with 32 witnesses and 12 days of hearings.

slots.name: disciplinary punishment
slots.sentence: The man who filed the lawsuit challenging his punishment was allowed to stay at Cornell, but he was ordered to stay away from the woman, take a class on sexual harassment and bystander intervention, and write a paper reflecting on the circumstances for which he was found responsible and include a proposal to train other students on preventing sexual harassment.

slots.name: student expulsion status
slots.sentence: Cornell hasn’t detailed the results of its investigation, but said it resulted in some students being expelled.
